subject: Job opening: Applied Statistics in Cognitive Sciences (Potsdam, Germany)

messages.subject: Job opening: Applied Statistics in Cognitive Sciences (Potsdam, Germany)
parts:
I hope it is OK to post a job opening here. Stan users and Bayesian statisticians would be very welcome!

The University of Potsdam, Structural Unit Cognitive Sciences is seeking to fill the following position by June 1st, 2016:

Junior Research Group Leader “Applied Statistics in Cognitive Sciences” (m/f)
Requisition No.: 104/2016

The position is for 40 hours of work per week (100%). The salary is determined by the collective bargaining agreement for public employees in Germany (TV-L E 13). This is a temporary position limited to a term of 3 years in accordance with Section 2 Para 1 of the Academic Fixed-Term Contract Law (WissZeitVG).

The junior research group is part of the university's structural unit on cognitive sciences. In addition to the position of the group leader, funding includes a budget for two PhD students (20 hours per week), for travelling and other expenses. 

The successful candidate will lead a new, independent research group on applied statistics in cognitive sciences. Areas of interest within cognitive sciences include experimental psycholinguistics, cognitive psychology, experimental linguistics, human movement and sport sciences, and other topics. The candidate must have a proven track record of high-quality international publications on applications of statistical methodology, ideally in several of the above mentioned application and research areas. The successful candidate should have teaching experience, and experience in writing research grant proposals and in obtaining third-party funding.

The candidate is expected to participate in related interdisciplinary research activities (e.g., experimental psycholinguistics, cognitive psychology, experimental linguistics, human movement and sport sciences) within the Faculty of Human Sciences at the University of Potsdam. These are, for example, (i) experimental design design and planning of appropriate data analyses for research in cognitive sciences, (ii) development of new methods for customized designs, (iii) application of newly developed statistical methods (e.g., linear mixed models and generalized additive mixed models), (iv) improving reproducible research via open access repositories for computer code and experimental data.

The group leader is expected to contribute to advanced-level teaching activities (one weekly 90 minute class per semester), in particular, to the new English-language MSc programs in Cognitive Science/Embodied Cognition and/or in Cognitive Systems. 

Applications should include a CV, a publication list, a third-party funding record, a teaching record, a brief research statement outlining the candidate's research plans for the next three years, and the names and email addresses of at least three senior scientists willing to provide letters of reference.

At least one third of the working time is reserved for academic work. The University strives  to achieve a balanced gender ratio in all occupational groups. The University of Potsdam provides support for dual career couples and families. Handicapped applicants will be given preference in case of equal suitability. People with an immigrant background are specifically encouraged to apply.

The university is located in the historical city of Potsdam, and its Golm campus, where Cognitive Sciences is based, is reachable by a direct and fast (30 minutes) train connection from Berlin, a vibrant and international city that offers an unbeatable quality of life.

Applicants should send their application materials, by April 5th, 2016 at the latest, either by mail to the University of Potsdam, Structural Unit on Cognitive Sciences, Building 14, Karl-Liebknecht-Straße 24-25, 14476 Potsdam, Germany, or via email to csch...@uni-potsdam.de with the subject line: Requisition No.: 104/2016.”

In order to return your application documents, we request that you include a self-addressed stamped envelope.

Potsdam, 08.03.2016
